title: the proof of the table: a place the runtime cannot run witnesses nothing, and a move the check cannot read is a defect
intent: The wave that repairs the proof of the track A (the wave A3) for the third time: the check of wave 85 promised more than it proved, and the discriminator of the package of the waves 84 and 86 named two findings that touch it (F19, F20).  The code of the kernel is honest; the proof is not.  The wave touches no code of the kernel.  (1) **A place that stands in no definition counted as live** (F19): the walk over the top-level forms of `lib/' gives such a place the name nil, and the rule of the liveness read the name nil as "a place the runtime runs".  A tick that stands in the body of a constant that nobody calls is not a move of the runtime, and the check counted it as the witness of the cell of that move -- the cell `(post-decide nudge . deciding)' passed, and the runtime does not take that move at all.  Such a place is dead for the runtime now, the report names the places of that kind apart from the others, and a cell whose only place is such a place is named together with the places that take its label.  (2) **A place whose label the check cannot read dropped out of every verdict** (F20): it witnessed no cell, it was compared with no state, and it broke the chain of the moves around it, so a runtime that took a move the machine does not have (`no-such-move') passed the check, the fan `error' lost its full coverage and stopped being judged, and the report said less than it said before -- all of it silently.  Such a place is a defect of its own now: the check names it by its file and its line and answers with the code 1.  (3) **The report is compared with the numbers it measured before**: a measurement that got smaller does not pass as if it were the same one -- a proof that rests on less is a weaker proof, and the check says so instead of staying quiet.
objection: The claim is about a proof and not about a run: the check is static on purpose, because there is no run that takes every move of the table -- a run that meets no busy provider never takes `rate-blocked', and a run that never grows long never takes `budget-overflow'.  The static check answers about the whole kernel at once, and it answers the same way twice.  The price is named and it is the price of wave 85 counted better: **nine of the twenty-three places of the kernel name no state**, so **fifteen of the thirty-one cells** rest on the machine alone, and the check lists those places and those labels by their file and their line.  The liveness is static: a definition that is reached only through a computed value is dead for the check, and the check says so.  The chain of the moves is read statically: a state that the runtime computes by a call is not read, and such a place names no state.  **The numbers of the report are pinned to the kernel of 2026-11-20**: a number changes when the kernel changes on purpose, and the constant is changed then and not before -- the price of "a measurement that got smaller does not pass as if it were the same one" is that a wave which changes `lib/' must change the constant of the check as well, and the check answers "the check measured the table differently than it measured it before" until it does.  The wave touches no code of the kernel: the table of the machine and the runtime are honest, and what was broken was the proof.
refuted_by: a cell of the table of the machine is not a move the machine makes, or a label of the table has no live place in the runtime where a run takes that move, or a live place takes the move of a cell from a state the cell does not lead from, or the runtime takes a move the machine does not have, or the runtime takes a move whose label the check cannot read, or a place of the runtime that stands in no definition of the kernel witnesses a cell, or the runtime narrows a fan of the table whose coverage the runtime states in full, or a fan of the table does not end in one state, or a state of the machine is not reachable from the first one through the cells of the table, or the check measured the table differently than it measured it before, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The claim of the wave is amended and not rewritten: the id `every-transition-of-the-table-is-taken' is the same, the text says that a live place is a place of a definition the runtime runs and that a place whose label the check cannot read is a defect of its own; the `falsifier' names the new refusals, and the `control' is the same.  Thirteen controls were applied to copies of the tree on 2026-11-20 -- nine by the writer of the wave and four more by the parent, and the parent's four were made independently of the report of the writer.  Every one of them ended with the verdict the control asked for.  (1) The honest tree -- the code 0, in 2.9 seconds.  (2) The tick of `nudge' in the body of a constant that nobody calls (F19) -- "the table of the machine names 1 cell(s) the runtime does not take: (((post-decide nudge . deciding) :the-runtime-does-not-take-the-move :the-places-that-take-the-label ((nil (nudge) "lib/yeah-turn.el:1481"))))" and "the check measured the table differently than it measured it before: ((:places-without-a-definition :expected 0 :measured 1) (:live-places :expected 23 :measured 22))"; code 1.  (3) The label of the tick cannot be read (F20) -- "the runtime takes 1 move(s) the check cannot read" with the file and the line of the place; code 1.  (4) The control of the claim -- four findings of the check, among them "1 cell(s) the runtime does not take" and "1 fan(s) the runtime does not keep"; code 1.  The measurement of the wave, recounted by the writer and by the parent: the table has thirty-one cells, seventeen labels and eleven states; the kernel has twenty-three places of a tick, and all of them are live; **zero** places stand outside a definition of the kernel and **zero** stand in a definition the runtime does not run; fourteen of the twenty-three places name the state of the run and nine do not; eight of the seventeen labels have no place that names a state; fifteen of the thirty-one cells rest on a place that names no state; two fans of the table, one with a stated coverage, one with a complete one (`error'), one without (`interrupt').
